'''2PO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] in the employ of [[Melnea Arnthout]], leader of a group of colonists to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was kidnapped by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] after only one season on the planet.<ref name="GG7" /> During his time with the Jawas he learned their language, and after Melnea rescued him he was instrumental in opening negotiations between the colonists and the Jawas.<ref name="RHP" />
